summary: Iteration 38: LMR Radar and Revogacao Cruzada Features Testing Complete. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: Radar LMR tab visible and functional, RadarLmrTab component renders with search form and stats, individual LMR analysis works with tax strategy/margins display, ChecklistPanel shows 5 checks with normas vigentes reference section.

VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/checklist with RDC 327/2019 returns revogacoes_detectadas array with revogada_por='RDC 660/2022', data_revogacao, observacao
VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/checklist returns sugestao_substituicao field in checks when norm is revoked
VERIFIED: POST /api/dama/checklist returns normas_vigentes_referencia object with importacao_excepcional, precificacao_cmed, bpf, lmr, licitacao keys
VERIFIED: Frontend Radar LMR tab (data-testid='tab-radar-lmr') visible in header navigation
VERIFIED: Frontend RadarLmrTab component renders with search form (lmr-busca-individual), stats cards, and opportunities list

VERIFIED: Frontend ChecklistPanel shows 5 checks with status icons (ok/alerta/bloqueio)
